title: Combine reviewed chase sends, recovery and UI coverage on the #161 line
public_pr_body:
Combine #191 and #199 with the #161 line that already contains merged #203/#204/#205. Resolve reviewed-text API field-name conflicts consistently with expected_subject/expected_body; retain the approval-button snapshot test, stale/missing-snapshot checks, strict subject preservation, atomic claim, retryable definite failures and Needs checking for uncertain results. Retain all test assertions from both sides; a no-rewrite assertion permits status-only claims and still forbids subject/body rewriting.

Base is chatgpt2/e2e-chasing-code-only (#161's branch), not main. Existing base documentation is unchanged so this code PR has no docs diff. No SQL applied. This remains an integration draft, not release approval; atomic settings proposals still require isolated database verification.

Validation: all 5,129 unit tests across 378 files passed. Typecheck passed; ESLint passed with three existing warnings and zero errors. Live browser/database tests and production build were not run. A separate follow-up resolves the existing settings-card layout conflict with main.
